question: Can a learned GRPO/System-One critique-reconstruct adapter trained only on synthetic orthogonal train split (3 seeds, model-derived calibrated confidence, no oracle alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/header_key/body_field/auth_scope) match the rule-based proxy on synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth alias-OOD (within 0.10 correct, 0.05 ECE) and generalize to live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld at BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees on header/body/auth aliasing including mixed multi-channel (header+body+query) within one request and production-SPA heterogeneity, preserving alias-OOD correct >=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10, McNemar p<0.05 vs exact matcher), false_accept <=0.15 (>=0.15 below verbatim replay p<0.05), exact-match >=0.90, UNKNOWN precision >=0.85, ECE <=0.15, with reported training cost/stability and retrieval+reconstruction+verification economics vs rule proxy and vs RAG?
hypothesis: A learned GRPO/System-One critique-reconstruct adapter trained exclusively on the synthetic orthogonal train split (header ApiKey/X-Reset-Token, body JSON field apiKey/key, auth permission families - not on held-out variations, not on mixed multi-channel, not on live BrowserGym) to map (intent, observation-derived state from DOM/AX at 1280x720 or synthetic URL/header/body dict, retrieved_template/candidates) -> reconstructed template/bound_action with model-derived calibrated confidence (softmax/budget-derived, not hardcoded, gated UNKNOWN when max_score<0.80, std>0.05) will (H1) match the genuine rule-based structural proxy within 0.10 absolute on synthetic orthogonal alias-OOD correct and within 0.05 on ECE (5 bins, bootstrap 2000), and (H2) generalize to live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld at BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees on header/body/auth aliasing including a mixed multi-channel stratum (header ApiKey + body apiKey + query permission co-occurring within one request) and production-SPA heterogeneity, achieving alias-OOD correct >=0.50 with binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 null and McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (expected 0/40), false_accept <=0.15 and >=0.15 below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY with McNemar p<0.05, while preserving exact-match correct >=0.90 and no-applicable UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 with ECE <=0.15. Training cost/stability (wall-clock, tokens/calls, per-seed variance/CV) and retrieval+reconstruction+verification economics vs rule proxy and vs TFIDF/embed RAG will be reported; rule proxy alone already achieves 30/30 1.0 on synthetic orthogonal (parent EXPERIMENTAL) but learnability and live mixed-channel generalization are the untested dominant unknowns.
falsifier: Hypothesis FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but any of: (F1) learned or rule synthesis fails alias-OOD primary on synthetic orthogonal 30+10 mixed (N>=40): correct <0.50 or binomial vs 0.10 p>=0.05 or McNemar vs B-EXACT-MATCH p>=0.05 or absolute correct <0.40; (F2) mixed multi-channel stratum (N=10) correct <0.40 or not significantly above chance when pooled synthetic fails isolation (diagnostic falsifier for multi-channel composition); (F3) false_accept on alias-OOD >0.25 or not >=0.15 below verbatim replay (paired McNemar p>=0.05); (F4) exact-match stratum correct <0.85 (reconstruction breaks non-aliased case, requires >=0.90 for RULE, >=0.85 for LEARNED); (F5) no-applicable UNKNOWN precision <0.70 or ECE >0.25 (calibration failure). Learned non-inferiority falsified if LEARNED underperforms RULE by >0.15 absolute correct on synthetic orthogonal or ECE exceeds RULE by >0.10 or stability CV>0.5 across 3 seeds (42,43,44). Live stratum falsified if N_live>=20 and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH passes but live alias-OOD correct <0.40 or false_accept >0.25. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires all S1-S7 gates plus not dominated by retrieval (>0.10 below best RAG verbatim) and controls PASS. Live exploratory if N_live<20 or PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH fails - then SURVIVES bounded to synthetic orthogonal+mixed with disclosure, not MEASUREMENT_INVALID. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC/NC fail, oracle leak detected (access to alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template in derived_context or hardcoded constant confidence), alias-OOD N<32 (30 orthogonal+mixed need 40, minimum 32), or >20% harness errors.
baselines: B-EXACT-MATCH (current SPIDER kernel): SpiderKernel.resolve with L97 exact intent equality, min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence. Prior 0/30 alias-OOD, expected 0/40 with mixed. ID B-EXACT-MATCH.

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY: Retrieve top-1 mechanism by exact intent equality scan in registry order; replay stored action_template verbatim via _bind without critique/rewriting. Aborts only if required_slots missing. Measures negative-transfer harm. ID B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.
B-RAG-TFIDF: TF-IDF retriever over mechanism intent+template strings; retrieve top-1 then verbatim bind. Tests retrieval alone. Fit only on train registry. ID B-RAG-TFIDF.

B-RAG-EMBED (strong retrieval): Sentence-transformer embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or equivalent offline) retriever over intent+template; top-1 then verbatim bind. If unavailable offline and deterministic, mark unavailable and use B-RAG-TFIDF as strong baseline with disclosure. Never uses ground-truth context signals. ID B-RAG-EMBED.
B-RANDOM: Uniform random among registry mechanisms whose intent matches and required_slots satisfied; else UNKNOWN. Chance-level baseline. ID B-RANDOM.

RECONSTRUCTION-RULE (genuine rule-based proxy): Deterministic structural scorer+rewriter conditioned only on (intent, observation-derived state from real DOM/AX tree or synthetic URL/header/body dict, retrieved_template/candidates) that scores slot count, path segments, query/header/body key presence, prefix structure and rewrites path<->query/header/body/auth including mixed multi-channel before _bind; confidence = softmax over candidate scores (temp 0.15) + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80. No hidden_expected access. ID RECONSTRUCTION-RULE.

RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED (GRPO/System-One): Learned critique-reconstruct adapter trained via GRPO or System-One scoring/budget exclusively on synthetic orthogonal train split (not on held-out-3 variations, not on mixed stratum, not on live BrowserGym) to map (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template) -> reconstructed template/bound_action with model-derived calibrated confidence; gated UNKNOWN<0.80. Confidence must vary (std>0.05). Report training cost/stability vs rule proxy across 3 seeds 42,43,44. ID RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-MATCH: On exact-match stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent equals registry intent verbatim, same slot names, preconditions match, no aliasing), all applicable methods (B-EXACT-MATCH, RECONSTRUCTION-RULE, and if available RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED) must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 with no crashes. Verifies pipeline resolves when no adaptation required; failure indicates harness/registry bug not hypothesis failure. Control ID: PC-EXACT-MATCH. PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH (exploratory gating): At least 80% of attempted live BrowserGym tasks must load DOM/AX tree at 1280x720 without truncation/timeout (CDP AX tree nodes>10, url and method observed). If <80% healthy, live stratum is exploratory and claim bounds to synthetic orthogonal+mixed only. Control ID: PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH.
null_control: NC-NO-APPLICABLE: On no-applicable stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism) every method must return UNKNOWN (or gated confidence<0.80) with UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10. NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY: Empty registry (N>=6) with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100% (validates kernel does not hallucinate). Failure indicates hallucination/miscalibration, triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Control IDs: NC-NO-APPLICABLE, NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY.
measurement_validity: Registry construction: For each synthetic orthogonal alias-OOD task, registry contains exactly one training mechanism (from alias train template) + one distractor alias template with equal confidence 0.9 + one exact-match distractor at 0.8, all preconditions={} guards={} to isolate aliasing. Test query uses held-out alias form with same semantic intent string as training (so exact matcher failure is due to template aliasing requiring reconstruction, not intent mismatch). No test template appears verbatim in registry (0/40 leakage: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed). Mixed multi-channel tasks: registry training mechanism uses single-channel form, test requires simultaneous header+body+query rewriting within one bound_action. Live BrowserGym tasks: sampled offline via BrowserGym 0.14.3 WebShop/ALFWorld at 1280x720; registry built from training trajectories, test tasks are held-out goal variations with aliased endpoint/field manifestation in observed AX/DOM; no test live template verbatim in registry. Preprocessing fit on TRAIN only.

State representation - genuine non-oracle with BrowserGym 1280x720: context dict provided to resolve/reconstruction contains ONLY observation-derived fields from real browser state: url (observed string at 1280x720), method, url_path, url_query dict, url_segments, headers_observed dict, body_observed (JSON/string if available), ax_tree_snapshot (CDP AX tree text snapshot hash and truncated 2k tokens for parsing, viewport 1280x720), and intent string. It MUST NOT contain ground-truth fixture signals alias_family, query_key, target_prefix, routing_prefix, target_style, path_style, header_key, body_field, auth_scope, expected_template or any field encoding alias answer. Those keys, if needed for scoring, stored separately as hidden_expected metadata not passed to any method. Observation-derived parsing is only allowed structural input besides intent and retrieved_template. Audit will inspect code for reads of forbidden keys and for hardcoded confidence constants. Synthetic orthogonal+mixed tasks use minimal derived dict without AX tree to isolate orthogonal alias mechanism plus mixed credit; live tasks use full AX-derived dict.

Action representation: Mechanism action_template is string template containing ${slot} parameters in URL path, query param, header value (e.g., ApiKey: ${token} or X-Reset-Token: ${token}), body JSON field, or auth scope, and for mixed tasks simultaneously header+body+query slots. Binding via deterministic kernel _bind plus header/body field substitution. Genuine reconstruction may score each candidate template's structural match to observation-derived state and/or rewrite template structure before _bind conditioned ONLY on (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template/candidates). Rewriter deterministic for RULE variant (must handle mixed multi-channel generically via alphabetically-sorted adopt-any-observed-key-not-in-registry + multi-field rewrite); learned for LEARNED variant. No hidden_expected access. Confidence must be derived from normalized structural score (softmax over candidates or rewrite confidence) and gated UNKNOWN at <0.80 for ECE; constant 0.95/0.05 hardcoding prohibited and triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Orthogonal alias families, mixed multi-channel, and held-out: Synthetic orthogonal 30 tasks = 3 families x10 intents: (a) header-based (ApiKey vs X-Reset-Token vs Authorization Bearer aliasing), (b) body JSON field (apiKey vs key vs api_key vs token), (c) auth permission (scope read vs admin_scope vs permission header). Each family 7 standard +3 held-out variations (e.g., novel header X-Api-Key, body field api_token, permission X-Scope) not in rewrite table requiring generalization via key/segment analysis. Report overall 10/family and held-out-9 subset. Mixed multi-channel stratum: 10 tasks where aliasing spans header+body+query within one request (e.g., header ApiKey + body apiKey + query permission simultaneously aliased to X-Api-Key + body key + header X-Scope), requiring joint multi-field rewriting; trained only on single-channel examples, not on mixed templates, to test compositional generalization. Live BrowserGym WebShop/ALFWorld: attempt 20+20 tasks with analogous header/body/query aliasing manifested in real request headers/body or URL aliasing observed in AX/DOM; add 10 live mixed tasks if feasible; exploratory if fewer. Production-SPA heterogeneity disclosed via BrowserGym viewport and AX diversity.

Learned GRPO/System-One training protocol: LEARNED adapter trained exclusively on synthetic orthogonal train split (not on held-out-3 variations, not on mixed stratum, not on any live BrowserGym task). Training uses 3 seeds (42,43,44) for stability; report per-seed alias-OOD correct (orthogonal and mixed), ECE, variance, wall-clock seconds, LLM calls/tokens if any, and convergence. If offline LLM unavailable, mark LEARNED unavailable and report RULE vs RAG only with disclosure; do not fabricate learned metrics. Confidence for LEARNED must be model-derived and vary across tasks (std>0.05), not constant. GRPO reward = correct_resolution - false_accept penalty with calibration bonus; System-One budget = scoring inference steps.

Determinism and seeds: All RNG via numpy.random.RandomState(seed=42) and Python random.seed(42) unless LEARNED seed 42/43/44 for stability reporting; no unseeded calls. BrowserGym Playwright viewport fixed 1280x720, CDP AX tree collection deterministic. Embedding retriever deterministic normalized embeddings. Each task evaluated once per method (paired design); bootstrap resampling for CIs uses block-permutation over tasks (2000 resamples) respecting trajectory grouping if live tasks grouped by site/session.

Holdout and leakage controls: All alias families and mixed stratum stratified; train never sees test alias form nor mixed composition (verify 0/40 synthetic orthogonal+mixed templates appear verbatim in registry; same for live if available). TF-IDF/embedding fit on train registry only. Reconstruction rule/learned model derived from training alias documentation only; held-out forms and mixed compositions require structural generalization. Audit checks no method accesses hidden_expected or test-template verbatim except via observation parsing. Registry intent-equality leak verified 0/40. Live tasks split by website (WebShop vs ALFWorld) with no site identity leakage into retriever.

Sample counts (minimum discriminating): Synthetic alias-OOD 30 orthogonal (10 per family incl 3 held-out) +10 mixed multi-channel =40, exact-match 12, no-applicable 12, empty-registry 6 =70 synthetic tasks per method x7 methods (5 baselines+2 reconstructions) =490 calls. Live BrowserGym: attempt 20 WebShop +20 ALFWorld =40 tasks +10 live mixed if feasible per method if accessible; exploratory only - if unavailable or >50% truncation/failed loads, mark exploratory and bound confirmatory claim to synthetic orthogonal+mixed with disclosure. Overall alias-OOD N>=40 required for confirmatory binomial/McNemar power (minimum 32 if live/mixed partially unavailable with disclosure); live stratum reported separately with Wilson CIs. WebShop/ALFWorld offline tasks use same correct/false_accept/UNKNOWN/ECE definitions; domain shift is exploratory.

Blinding and oracle prohibition: Genuine adapters not tuned on test alias forms nor on mixed compositions; held-out variations and mixed stratum excluded from mapping table and from LEARNED training data. Context forbidden keys filtered at harness level before resolve call (derive_state from observed URL/headers/body/AX, not from fixture). Harness exposes reconstruct_resolve(intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params) signature. Mixed tasks audit that rewriter does not memorize mixed template but composes single-channel rewrites.

Verification and metrics: correct_resolution = resolved template binds to URL/header/body that verifies against expected postcondition (hidden_expected_template bound equality including header/body field equality and for mixed all channels jointly correct); false_accept = resolved to wrong template or bound incorrectly or should have abstained; UNKNOWN = correctly abstained when no applicable mechanism or gated confidence<0.80. All three sum to 1.0 per stratum. Calibration via ECE over 5 confidence bins (confidence derived from structural/model score) plus abstention precision/recall; Wilson 95% CI for rates; one-sided binomial vs 0.10; McNemar paired for reconstruction vs exact and vs verbatim; bootstrap ECE CI. Training cost/stability and verification-boundary economics reported as exploratory secondary metrics: train wall-clock, tokens/calls, stability std/CV across 3 seeds, retrieval+reconstruction+verification steps per task and amortized cost vs RAG and vs verbatim; but they do not gate SURVIVES (reported with Wilson/bootstrap). Mixed stratum reported separately plus pooled alias-OOD.

Oracle prohibition auditability: Harness code must expose reconstruct_resolve functions for RULE and LEARNED that take only (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params) where derived_context excludes forbidden keys. Confidence derivation inspectable (score computation visible). Reading task alias_family etc. or constant confidence triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per parent audit fixes. Mixed stratum code inspection verifies compositional rewriting not memorized mixed fixture.
decision_rule: All primary thresholds on synthetic alias-OOD pooled (N>=40: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed) unless stated; live BrowserGym stratum reported separately. Compute per-method correct_resolution, false_accept, UNKNOWN rates with Wilson 95% CI; paired McNemar for reconstruction vs B-EXACT-MATCH (correct) and vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (false_accept); one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null; bootstrap block-permutation ECE CI (2000 resamples, trajectory-grouped if live). SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (1) PC-EXACT-MATCH passes (correct >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 for B-EXACT-MATCH and RECONSTRUCTION-RULE on exact-match stratum), (2) NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes (UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10) AND NC-EMPTY 100% UNKNOWN, (3) alias-OOD pooled S1: RECONSTRUCTION-RULE correct >=0.50 AND binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 AND McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (expected 0/40), and orthogonal subset correct >=0.50 and mixed subset correct >=0.40 diagnostic (mixed <0.40 triggers bounded falsification for composition), (4) S2: RECONSTRUCTION-RULE false_accept <=0.15 AND strictly below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY by >=0.15 absolute with McNemar p<0.05 on false_accept, (5) S3: reconstruction exact-match stratum correct >=0.90 (no regression) for both RULE and if LEARNED available also >=0.85, (6) S4: reconstruction no-applicable precision >=0.85 AND ECE <=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence) for RULE (LEARNED reported separately), (7) not dominated by retrieval: RECONSTRUCTION-RULE pooled correct not >0.10 below best RAG (TFIDF/embed) verbatim correct on same alias-OOD. Learned non-inferiority exploratory: LEARNED pooled correct within 0.10 of RULE and ECE within 0.05; if LEARNED underperforms by >0.15 or ECE exceeds by >0.10 or CV>0.5, LEARNED falsified but RULE may still SURVIVE. Live BrowserGym exploratory confirmation (if N_live>=20 and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH passes): report same S1-S2 thresholds on live pooled+orthogonal+mixed; synthesis SURVIVES requires synthetic pooled gates plus live alias-OOD correct >=0.50 with binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 and false_accept <=0.15; if live fails but synthetic passes, overall SURVIVES bounded to synthetic orthogonal+mixed with disclosure. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but pooled S1 or S2 or S3 or S4 fails (or mixed <0.30 with pooled <0.50). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC or NC fails, or audit detects oracle leak or hardcoded confidence or constant confidence, or pooled alias-OOD N<32, or >20% harness errors, or intent-equality registry leakage.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES (synthetic orthogonal+mixed + live BrowserGym with calibration and learned non-inferiority within 0.10/0.05): Genuine non-oracle reconstruction/adaptation beyond URL path/query to orthogonal header/body/auth aliasing including mixed multi-channel composition and live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld provides applicability resolution beyond exact matcher and verbatim replay with calibrated abstention. Product should add reconstruction layer after retrieval (critique-reconstruct conditioned on intent+observation-derived state from DOM/AX at 1280x720+retrieved template, confidence-gated UNKNOWN<0.80) before execution, with verification/repair boundary and freshness guard. Unblocks cross-site parameterized transfer where header/body/auth aliasing is common, addresses MemHarness negative-transfer and freshness/UNKNOWN abstention prior, and justifies sequencing to workflow-compilation (Artic/FlowSearcher) after resolution. Frontier claim C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances to EXPERIMENTAL (bounded to genuine reconstruction on tested orthogonal families plus mixed composition and live BrowserGym with calibrated UNKNOWN, both rule and learned if non-inferior) - not PRODUCT_CORE until end-to-end economics replicate at scale. Report economics: retrieval+reconstruction+verification cost per successful task vs RAG vs verbatim; training cost/stability vs rule proxy.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: Genuine state-conditioned structural reconstruction does not beat exact matcher/verbatim on controlled orthogonal aliasing (header/body/auth) or on mixed multi-channel composition or on live BrowserGym, or only by inflating false_accepts/miscalibration (ECE failure), or learned variant fails to match rule proxy (>0.15 gap or >0.10 ECE or CV>0.5). Product must NOT add reconstruction layer as product feature for these families/compositions/live; keep exact-intent matching and require agents to supply exact intents or pre-normalized templates; prioritize explicit alias catalogs, server-side routing normalization, or per-site header/body mapping tables. Frontier mechanism closed for this adapter class and families incl held-out/mixed/live; next Frontier attack should test orthogonal basin (artifact-driven workflow compilation, hierarchical DAG synthesis, program-synthesis repair, cache invalidation) rather than tuning reconstruction thresholds. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains HYPOTHESIS (bounded falsification for tested genuine adapter on tested orthogonal families/mixed/live, not global falsification of all semantic resolution). Learned GRPO failure indicates training instability or synthetic-to-real gap, not blanket rejection of critique-reconstruct class.
estimated_cost: Low-moderate: 70 synthetic (40 alias-OOD orthogonal+mixed +12 exact +12 no-applicable +6 empty) + up to 50 live (40 single +10 mixed) =120 tasks x7 methods =840 deterministic kernel resolve+bind calls plus TF-IDF/embedding retrieval offline (<20 min CPU no LLM for RULE arm). LEARNED GRPO training adds 1-4h wall-clock if using local small LM (e.g., 7B) or hosted LLM ~300k-600k tokens for critique-reconstruct fine-tune with 3 seeds (42,43,44); report wall-clock/tokens/calls and CV. Live BrowserGym at 1280x720 adds <50 Playwright navigations with CDP AX extraction (<40 min if fixtures local, <6 min per 20 tasks). Total compute <5h on single runner, no large datasets committed, no giant raw data. Offline embedding local CPU. If LLM unavailable, LEARNED arm disclosed as unavailable and cost drops to <40 min.
expected_information_gain: Very high: First valid test of learned (GRPO/System-One) vs rule-based genuine structural reconstruction with 3-seed stability/ECE and first orthogonal-family (header ApiKey/X-Reset-Token, body JSON field, auth permission) plus novel mixed multi-channel (header+body+query within one request) composition plus live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld validation at BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees and production-SPA heterogeneity - directly addresses Director REOPEN mandate and parent handoff's two dominant unknowns (learnability/training cost/stability and synthetic-to-real gap) plus compositional generalization. Either outcome changes product/architecture decision: positive validates retrieval+reconstruction vs exact matcher for broader aliasing and unblocks cross-site transfer sequencing with calibrated abstention and measured economics; negative falsifies adaptation prior for orthogonal families/mixed/live and cleanly parks semantic claim forcing pivot to compilation/synthesis. Strong baselines (exact, verbatim, TFIDF, embed, random) and PC/NC with calibration gates (UNKNOWN precision, ECE) plus header/body/auth/mixed non-vacuous isolation and trajectory-grouped permutation ensure result not explained by retrieval strength, hallucination, or vacuous C4 where full==body. Orthogonal to 30+ prior freshness/PMI/TV loops and to narrow URL-only POC (30/30 synthetic), satisfying frontier charter to leave solution basin. Reports training cost/stability and verification-boundary economics vs rule proxy and RAG for product decision.
